issues.problem: Misuse 1 'why' claimed the expression cannot follow 很 because it is a noun, contradicting the card's own 'how' (有点马后炮) and real colloquial use.
issues.action: Rewrote the reason to rest on meaning only: it mocks belated action and cannot describe preparing ahead.

issues.problem: 'near' diff overstated: 莫名其妙 can also describe a baffled person (让人莫名其妙), not only an odd thing.
issues.action: Reworded the diff: 莫名其妙 stresses that something is odd and unexplained; 一头雾水 is the confusion of someone who cannot follow.

issues.problem: Context 5 (a singer acting superior to the backstage crew) is the textbook case for the listed near-synonym 耍大牌.
issues.action: Replaced it with a doctor acting superior to patients, where only 摆架子 fits.

issues.problem: Context 2 (fixating after criticism, thinking everyone hates her), context 5 (dwelling on a break-up) and the cue (brooding over a stranger's look) fit 想不开 (gy074, same set) just as well.
issues.action: Rewrote context 2 (hung up on a teacher's offhand remark), context 5 (chicken-or-egg, 越想越钻牛角尖) and the cue (stuck on one exam question, won't move on) so they are about getting stuck on one point, not taking a setback hard.

issues.problem: Context 1 (exam tomorrow, must cram) and the cue (exam tomorrow morning, opening the textbook) fit 开夜车 (gy001, same set) equally well.
issues.action: Moved context 1 and the cue to an hour or ten minutes before the exam, where staying up all night is not possible.
